blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Inflation may have climbed to its highest level in five months in September, moving further above the government’s target as bad weather disrupted food supplies and higher oil prices added to cost pressures. The consumer price index may have accelerated to 6.8 percent last month, according to the median estimate of 19 economists […]...
